name: FFS_ACTIVITY_SEGMENT_MODE
description: Stores method to be used to manage segments of a multi-day activity for a particular day.

columns.name: ARCH_DATE
columns.description: DB record partitioning date. Set automatically by DB Optimization job.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the segmentable activity, its segments are assigned to the RESOURCE_ID on the date ROUTE_DATE. It is the foreign key to the table FFS_ACTIVITY.

columns.name: ROUTE_DATE
columns.description: Date Of The Route Which Segments Of The Segmentable Activity Activity_Id Are Assigned To.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier Of The Resource Who Segments Of The Segmentable Activity Activity_Id Are Assigned To. It Can Be A Filed Resource As Well As A Bucket.

columns.name: TOTAL_COUNT
columns.description: Total number of segments of the segmentable activity ACTIVITY_ID that are assigned to the RESOURCE_ID on the day ROUTE_DATE.

columns.name: TOTAL_DURATION
columns.description: Total duration of all segments of the segmentable activity ACTIVITY_ID that are assigned to the RESOURCE_ID on the date ROUTE_DATE regardless the status of the segments.

columns.name: STARTED_DURATION
columns.description: Duration of the started segment of the segmentable activity ACTIVITY_ID that is assigned to the RESOURCE_ID on the day ROUTE_DATE.

columns.name: FINISHED_COUNT
columns.description: Total number of all segments with the final status that belong to the segmentable activity ACTIVITY_ID and are assigned to the RESOURCE_ID on the date ROUTE_DATE.

columns.name: FINISHED_DURATION
columns.description: Total duration of all segments with the final status that belong to the segmentable activity ACTIVITY_ID.

columns.name: CANCELLED_COUNT
columns.description: Total number of all cancelled segments that belong to the segmentable activity ACTIVITY_ID and are assigned to the RESOURCE_ID on the date ROUTE_DATE.

columns.name: OPTIONS
columns.description: Binary representation of the number is the set of boolean flags which are responsible for different assignment options.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
